name: SaltStack Nornir Proxy Minion Docker
what_it_is: A single-container Docker environment running SaltStack Master, Salt-API, and a Nornir Proxy Minion together, pre-configured with always-on Cisco sandbox devices (IOS-XE, IOS-XR, NX-OS). Designed to accelerate getting started with Salt-Nornir network automation without manual installation.
measurement: nr.nornir stats — Nornir Proxy Minion statistics
nr.nornir inventory — full inventory content inspection
nr.nornir hosts — list of managed host names
test.ping — verify proxy minion process is alive
configuration: SALT_VERSION env var — SaltStack version to install (default: 3006.5)
LOG_LEVEL env var — logging verbosity (default: debug)
PROXY_ID env var — Nornir Proxy Minion ID (default: nrp1)
SALT_MASTER env var — enable/disable salt-master process (True/False)
SALT_API env var — enable/disable salt-api process (True/False)
SALT_PROXY env var — enable/disable salt-proxy process (True/False)
SALT/saltstack/master — master config (PKI dir, file/pillar roots, REST API, external_auth)
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanisms are present in the repository
Proxy Minion restart via docker restart saltstack can simulate connectivity loss
Removing or corrupting pillar/nrp1.sls simulates misconfiguration scenarios
modes: Proxy-only mode: SALT_PROXY=True with external master
constraints: Single-container design — master, API, and proxy all run inside one container; no multi-node clustering
Python 3.9.7 only — base image is fixed to python:3.9.7-slim-bullseye
Pillar changes require a full docker restart saltstack to take effect; no hot-reload
Salt-API runs HTTP only by default (disable_ssl: True); TLS requires manual reconfiguration
Always-on sandbox devices (Cisco DevNet) depend on external network connectivity and third-party uptime
notable_absences: No dedicated network device simulators (GNS3, EVE-NG, containerlab) — relies on external Cisco DevNet always-on sandboxes
No persistent database or metrics store (no InfluxDB, Prometheus, etc.)
No TLS/HTTPS configured out of the box for Salt-API
No automated test suite or CI pipeline in the repository
